call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: After-Hours Stock Reaction (-25.7%) vs. Q4 Guidance Optics
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Ken, Q3 was a standout print with billings up 29% and product revenue up 37%, yet the stock is down over 25% in the aftermarket. Is this purely multiple compression from Q4 revenue guidance ($2.20B mid) coming in slightly below whisper expectations, or are you seeing any lengthening sales cycles in enterprise refresh deals?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Ken Xie explained that the underlying demand fundamentals remain exceptionally robust, as evidenced by raising full-year billings for the third time this year. The Q4 guidance reflects traditional management conservatism around large enterprise deal timing across the December fiscal year-end. With product gross margins expanding and the AI firewall upgrade cycle just beginning, Fortinet's market share gains in secure networking remain completely intact.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Product Revenue Acceleration (+37% YoY) & AI Security Convergence
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Christian, product revenue grew 37% to $765 million, which is the strongest growth in over two years. How much of this acceleration is driven by the FortiOS 8.0 cycle and NVIDIA OpenShell partnerships, and how sustainable is this product run-rate into 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO Christian Schenk noted that the product acceleration is broad-based across enterprise tiers. Customers are consolidating disparate point products into Fortinet's unified platform. The partnership with NVIDIA to secure AI infrastructure with FortiASIC-powered appliances is opening up enterprise AI data center deployments that previously did not exist, creating a multi-year hardware refresh runway.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Gross Margin Sustainability (80%) & Free Cash Flow Generation
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: You delivered $865 million in free cash flow and a 38% operating margin while boosting the buyback authorization by $1.2 billion. How are you balancing investments into SASE and sovereign cloud partnerships while maintaining these 80% gross margins?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Ken Xie highlighted that Fortinet's proprietary FortiASIC architecture delivers a structural 3x to 5x cost advantage over commodity CPU-based security appliances. This architectural moat allows Fortinet to invest heavily in cloud SASE points-of-presence and generative AI security features while consistently generating ~40% free cash flow margins and funding $2 billion in share buybacks.
